priority_rows.claim_text: Internal AGN feedback processes drive powerful outflows that eject gas or heat circumgalactic gas, quenching star formation via starvation.
priority_rows.summary: [page58_neutral_seed_v1 gold_id=stance2b-051] However, we do not yet fully understand how this feedback mechanism – jets acting on the cooler phases of the ISM – works in detail; there also remain considerable uncertainties about the masses and kinetic powers of the resulting jet-induced outflows, and the extent to which they can truly affect the evolution of the host galaxies.
